Review security M1 (calibrated M). Store.safe_decode/read paths, spec.triangle tracer-manifest read (spec.triangle.ex:132-140), and coverage_closure decode :erlang.binary_to_term without [:safe] — atom-exhaustion/ETF-bomb DoS from a hostile committed artifact.
